subject: Oktoberfest 2024 Community Recap
overview: Medford Bites recapped the city's recent Oktoberfest celebration and shared community feedback gathered during the event. The episode featured highlights from local businesses and reflections from residents on the city's schools, dining, and culture.

items.title: Introduction and Oktoberfest Event Recap
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca recapped her experience at the Chamber of Commerce Oktoberfest, highlighting local food vendors and youth activities.

items.title: Sponsor Spotlight: Chevalier Theatre
items.summary: The program promoted the upcoming 'Gazillion Bubble Show' scheduled for its Medford debut at the Chevalier Theatre on December 8th.

items.title: Community Voices: What I Love About Medford
items.summary: Residents and local officials shared positive testimonials regarding the city's public schools, the library, recreational sports leagues, and local inclusivity.
